.300 Winchester Magnum Load Search

SAFETY: data copied from loaddata.com listings (various published and third-party sources: Hodgdon, Hornady, Sierra, Barnes, Nosler, Speer, Berger, Lee, Handloader and others; some loads are individual handloader data in specific rifles). Copying errors are possible. Always cross-check against the current manufacturer manual, start low and work up. Not a substitute for a manual. Pressure and maximum-load marks may be lost in conversion, so treat the highest charge listed for any combination with caution.
READ-ONLY SNAPSHOT of 70 .300 Winchester Magnum listings from loaddata.com (3970 loads, built 2026-10-29). Each row shows one charge exactly as printed (these listings have a single Charge column; start/max is given in Remarks where the source says so). The Charge sort uses that single listed charge. This page needs no internet.
